extracted_information: The Microsoft Defender for Endpoint APIs expose data and actions to automate workflows and integrate with Defender for Endpoint capabilities. API access requires OAuth 2.0 authentication.

features.name: General API Usage Steps
features.description: 1. Create a Microsoft Entra application. 2. Get an access token using this application. 3. Use the token to access Defender for Endpoint API.

features.name: Application Context Access (Recommended)
features.description: Used by apps running without a signed-in user (e.g., background services, daemons). Steps: 1. Create a Microsoft Entra Web-Application. 2. Assign desired permissions (e.g., 'Read Alerts', 'Isolate Machines'). 3. Create a key for the application. 4. Get token using the application with its key. 5. Use the token to access the API.

features.name: User Context Access
features.description: Used to perform actions in the API on behalf of a user. Steps: 1. Create a Microsoft Entra Native-Application. 2. Assign desired permissions (e.g., 'Read Alerts', 'Isolate Machines'). 3. Get token using the application with user credentials. 4. Use the token to access the API.

features.name: Data Paging
features.description: When more than one query request is required to retrieve all results, Microsoft Graph returns an '@odata.nextLink' property in the response containing a URL to the next page of results.

references: Paging Microsoft Graph data in your app
